source: separate latest state energy snapshot; do not splice original data
origins: every calendar day Jan1 through Dec18 of each year so 14-day forecasts stay in year
training: annual refit on previous 730 calendar days; same span across classical models; no tuning
models: ridge alpha10, SARIMAX (1,0,0)x(1,0,0,7), last value, weekly repeat, pinned Chronos-2
chronos_daily: history-only mode on every origin; no fine-tuning
chronos_calendar: matched predeclared Diwali windows only; not falsely reported as all-year calendar evaluation
festival_window: union +/-3 days around national main Diwali anchor plus documented state main celebration dates; all observed event days score
calendar_verification: every source and mismatch recorded; unverified state/year flags remain explicitly unverified
untouched_status: 2022/2023 previously examined; 2024/2025 not previously scored; no parameter tuning after this declaration
limitations: overlap unknown pending audit; no global no-contamination guarantee; shared-source correlated states not independent festival replications

post_upload_supplement.basis: Pinned and first-upload model weight LFS hashes match; 2026 labels postdate 2025-10-30 upload
post_upload_supplement.festival: No 2026 Diwali observations yet; cannot claim post-upload Diwali validation

calendar_model_scope: All-year ridge A/B/D; all-year Chronos A; matched event-target Chronos B/D only; no unverified generic holiday flags in expanded primary comparison
calendar_correction_before_feature_resul: 2020/2021 main anchors explicitly included in rolling training context; 2022/2023 Balipadyami dates included. Numeric history-only forecasts are reusable; event membership recomputed. No calendar-model outputs inspected before correction.
